The weighted port throughput calculation was successfully implemented and verified with a perfect reward score and passing test suite.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.81 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite with a duration of 0.39s. While the logic is reusable, future iterations should re-check edge case assumptions in the weighted-risk-assessment logic to maintain the high reward mean.
